svg.title: JenniferKate Family PRYSM iO Score Tracker
svg.desc: An editable, printable family score tracker with writing space for dates, scores, and colorful foods or wellness habits.
svg.text: A family tool for noticing habits and celebrating effort.
Use with a grown-up. PRYSM iO is intended for children ages 3 and older.
Created by JenniferKate™ | RemiKate Collective LLC
Personal family-use printable for sharing. Not for resale or official Nu Skin material.
A score is for wellness tracking, not diagnosis. Follow device instructions.
Ask your child’s healthcare professional about nutrition and supplements.
